reviews.text:
I took my puppy here for routine vaccines and I was not disappointed!! The staff were all extremely friendly and welcoming, the doctor was very attentive and informative. She even gave my boy a treat dispenser toy which he loves so much!! Prices are also reasonable and the wait times weren’t bad at all! (I came in the morning though, so that could be why)
I would definitely recommend this vet clinic to anyone in the area!!

I had a wonderful experience at this veterinary clinic.Everyone was extremely kind, professional, and caring.I brought my 5-month old albino Doberman, and the staff treated him with so much patience and love.
They took the time to explain everything clearly especially regarding his vaccines and overall care. I left very comfortable knowing that my puppy was in good hands.
I'm very happy with the services and highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for compassionate and professional care for their pets. We will definitely be coming back
Excellent services and the staff My worried about my pet and the very special Dr. a spectacular attention

We recently said goodbye to our senior German Shepherd, Duke, at Redland Animal Hospital. It was an incredibly hard day, but the team was compassionate and gentle from start to finish. They offered Duke treats, spoke softly, and gave us the space and time we needed without feeling rushed. Their kindness made an awful moment a little more bearable. We’re deeply grateful for the care and dignity they showed Duke and our family.

I had been bringing my cat Luke here for almost a year after he was diagnosed with cancer until he passed away yesterday at 9 years old. To put it simply, this is the best group of people you could ever bring your pets to. Thank you for everything Dr. K and all the amazing techs here.
The staff and doctor are amazing. We’ve been coming here since we moved to Homestead for over 3 years now. Best animal hospital ever. Today we came to get his rabies, he feels like at home 🫶 …
I can’t say enough about how wonderful this experience was for my Frances. Caring and genuine love for your pet. They took such good care of Frances and me ♥️

First time coming for 1 of my many community cats. He seemed to have been hit by a car and there was no solution other than euthanizing him. My mother and I were devastated . the staff was kind and empathetic. The doctors showed us humanity for a "stray" that many consider a pest ...but for us that care (he was another of God's creature that deserved love and to go peacefully without suffering. Thank you ❤️
Great customer service!!!

Everyone here was so nice and it was great.  However, the owner is not presently involved in the situation and it’s being run by employees. I was taking my dog there many years for an annual physicals while they told me everything was OK and the cost of the annual physical always seemed absorbently high due to small fees, adding up from random vaccines they kept telling me everything was OK and I was maintaining his health. Meanwhile, his teeth were rotting out horribly and he ended up needing to have every single tooth pulled for a $3000 dental bill down the line shortly after seeing them one year later while they kept telling me for years that he was OK.  The major oversight on their part and my health insurance for the dog even declined the claim saying that the vet should’ve had the teeth cleaned once a year in order for the health insurance claim to be approved. Meanwhile, the vet mentioned nothing about this, so I was extremely disappointed and hope they would never allow us to continue to happen to other people’s dogs who want their teeth. It’s a serious issue because he can’t even close his mouth now.

I took my two cats there for their rabies vaccine and it was a great experience! The front desk workers and vet were all very kind and empathetic, and my cats felt very safe. Wait time was not long and I am 100% satisfied with the experience. Two happy cats!
Thank you for taking the time to leave us a review!

Redland Animal Hospital provides great service through a caring and competent staff, convenient hours, and clean cheery space. I have taken my Cavapoo there since August for vaccinations/check up and one about of diarrhea.  Each visit the staff and vet have been attentative and sincere in their care of my beloved puppy. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a caring, reliable, and professional animal hospital.

Julie, the front desk receptionist was very nice and helpful any time,being very worried about the health of my dog Tom, same opinion regarding to the technician working there( Nathalie and other) but unfortunately the Doctors make wrong diagnostic before and after labs and X rays, and prescribed strong unnecessary medication (Gabapentin), furosemide that made my dog really weak them spoke about neurological issues, so recommendations to do CT scan , plus other neurological Exams at Doral hospital), so from an inflammation in rear joint leg to neurological/brain issues show me that the Doctors are selling me information  and exams that I knew but don’t apply for my dog , as soon That I stop both medications Tom started to walk again, never again I will bring my Dog to Redland Animal Hospital and Zero Recomendation
My vet for the past 20 years, small clinic full of super heroes 🫡 …
Thank you for taking the time to share your experience!

I recently just started going to redland animal hospital after our previous vet's office closed every one there are excellent Dr Bushnell is amazing all the staff are kind and loving with all my cats if your looking for the best place for your animals redland animal hospital is it
Thank you for taking the time to share your experience!
Great workers here who genuinely care about your animals. They are also great about getting you an appointment when needed. Thank you guys for always taking great care of Milo & Zuma.
Great staff, they are very caring for both pets & people.

I've been bringing my pets here for about 4 years now and have other family members who also bring their pets here. There is a reason that we do, the people here care for and truly love and have a passion for animals. I can confidently tell you that none of my pets have ever felt uncomfortable or fearful while here. They are comfortable with all of the staff and the vets are very knowledgeable, understanding and kind. I appreciate everyone for all their help within these last few years that have made having pets easier and more enjoyable. My pets are happy and healthy and it's definitely with their support.
Absolute best vet clinic in this area.

After taking my pet here for many years since I got my pet, unfortunately there was an incident that really rubbed me the wrong way and one of the assistants in the clinic really got rude and nasty and made me feel uncomfortable. There has been a decline in the customer service and overall the place has been in major decline. I do not recommend this location.
Great service. 😃 very reliable. …

This place deserves 20 stars 🌟. These guys are amazing, friendly helpful, you can notice from the beginning the true love for animals here. I was referred by my friend and l have to say thank you for everything that you do for your kindness, your care, and love not only with the dogs and cats but also with the owners as well. I'm happy to say that l found my furry place 🐕🐾

This place is great, I called a few other clinics to see my dog, and all of them were busy, This place went out their Way to make space on their busy day to see me short notice! Doctor Bushnell found out what was wrong with my dog in minutes.
The staff is very nice and caring, and the doctor is one of the best doctors I’ve interacted with. The facility is super clean.

There is so much I want to say on behalf of Milo and my family but the words are still hard to say. Regardless, I want to recognize Redland Animal Hospital, the ENTIRE staff, Doctors, Reception, everyone for the way they made sure Milo was taken care of. Milo Grigg Montero was adopted on June 15, 2018 and sadly passed away June 18, 2025. Since the moment we adopted him to the very end, Milo was adored by all of us. He was an angel that came to bring happiness, joy and unconditional love to our home. Redland Animal Hospital was his second home and was treated with the utmost respect, love and attention. Missy, you bonded with him, he’s not one to bond with anyone that’s not his family and he loved you for it. Thank you EVERYONE for treating him like your own and this goes for all the pets that are cared for by you all. We miss him terribly, the pain and sadness is still too raw but he’s no longer suffering and now he can finally eat anything he wants. We love you Milo and we love you all for loving him❤️🙏🏻
Daisy Grigg and Family.

I’m going to start by apologizing for this long post, but I have lots to say :) I adopted a rescue a couple  of years back and I live in the Florida Keys. My pup, Bubbles, is terrified of vet visits, so much so, that my current vet in the Keys is not able to draw blood from her to be able to fill her heartworm prescription. Being a very responsible pet owner, I never miss giving my dog her monthly  heartworm prevention, so when my current vet told me that aren’t able to draw her blood because she won’t stay still and becomes aggressive (even after giving her calming meds), I was pretty desperate and not sure what to do. My dog had been seen at Redlands Animal Hospital for her initial vet exam and spay two years ago right before I officially adopted her, so I decided to take her there to see if they could do a successful blood draw to refill her prescription. Let me tell you, it was so worth the drive! The staff is incredible! Dr. Bushnell, Jessie, Jillian, Melany, Julie, and Natalie, thank you all so very much! Your team was able to take blood and trim her nails that she lets no one do! I know Bubbles is not an easy pooch, but you were all so sweet, loving, gentle, and patient with her. You have an amazing team and I will make the drive every time! I feel like a weight has been lifted off my shoulders- it was a great day! Thank you again! I will definitely recommend your practice to other Keys residents!
Thank you for taking the time to share your experience!
Everyone is so kind and my dog absolutely loves them. They are thorough, flexible, patient and caring. Definitely would recommend!
Thank you for taking the time to share your experience with our office!
Redland Animal Hospital is the best. Experienced, professional and caring staff. Your animal will always get the best care. I highly recommend this Veterinary.

I want to sincerely thank everyone at Redland Animal Hospital their willingness to go the extra mile, and for for the kindness they showed. Cannot say enough good things. They (Julie) got me in for an exam the same day when I called for a last minute appointment for my furbaby, who I felt absolutely needed to be seen asap. Dr. Bushnell & her staff are the absolute BEST, they helped calm my anxiety, they treated my baby lovingly and explained everything in terms that were easy to understand. The whole staff made me feel amazing, and the care my dog got was awesome. Dr. Bushnell is very patient, friendly, and knowledgeable she explained everything beforehand and is very thorough. I absolutely love this vet. SHE IS AMAZING!!! My Chewie baby got himself a new vet. Highly highly recommend 🐶👏
Thank you for taking the time to leave a review for us!

My name is Daisy Grigg, David is my husband and we started attending this hospital since we adopted our very unique, “i do what i want, but i love and protect my family” dog, Milo. He’s a rat terrier now about 9 years old we would say. We can’t say enough about this facility and everyone who works here. They have treated Milo and us like family. Very professional, very caring, attentive and always concerned. Milo needed dental work and was postponed 3 times due to other issues that would occur with him but when finally performed, we ALL couldn’t be happier at how smoothly it went. He’s a strong dog despite his size and not easy to work with as he was adopted and has trust issues but he loves Missy and has taken to everyone there. The doctors are open to speaking with the families, the reception is always cheerful even when you are worried making the process so much easier. Milo is still not 100% but he’s getting the care he needs both at home and at Redland. Every animal is treated with respect, love and dignity. We absolutely love this hospital and everyone in it. I don’t have names i wish i did but they all know who they are, even those  that have to struggle to cut his nails lol.  We highly recommend this facility, know that when you have to leave them there for the day, they are cared for as if they are at home.  Thank you for taking care of our children because that’s what they are but with fur❤️🙏🏻

One of the saddest moments in my life the day I ran into this hospital crying that my dog was dying and to please help me. It was and still is the most painful day when my dog died. The staff moved into action right away and took her in. …
This place was an extraordinary choice to put our beloved family dog to sleep. They are caring, conscious and have a good heart. Highly recommend it.

Great & loving care for my cat Milo, who isn’t used to anyone but me. They made him comfortable & cozy while he was away from me. Redland Animal hospital is very clean and organized. Such a wonderful & caring staff. I highly recommend them …
